name: Bank Islam Malaysia Berhad
overview: 2026年，Bank Islam Malaysia Berhad 未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售事项；公告主要为季度业绩、公司治理变动、股东大会及股息除权安排。
overview_en: In 2026, Bank Islam Malaysia Berhad did not disclose any expansion, new business, reduction, or divestment of business segments in its announcements; the announcements mainly covered quarterly results, corporate governance changes, general meetings, and dividend ex-date arrangements.
